scripts.text: You have too many kinds of objects. Let's try to continue after reducing those objects.
scripts.translation: 你带的物品种类太多了。减少一些物品后再试吧。

scripts.text: Can't continue because you have too many heavy objects. Let's try to continue after reducing the weight.
scripts.translation: 你带的重物太多，无法继续。减轻负重后再来吧。

scripts.text: Long time no see~
scripts.translation: 好久不见~

scripts.text: I have learned a new skill that separates cards from Armor, Shoes, Garment and Headgear. Do you want to try it?
scripts.translation: 我学会了一种新技能，可以从铠甲、鞋子、披肩和头饰上拆下卡片。要试试看吗？

scripts.text: Silly Jeremy does not want to touch weapons and shields because of picking several cards that might be damaged. That is why I prepared a card separaion skill for weapons and shields...
scripts.translation: 傻瓜杰里米不想碰武器和盾牌，因为拆卡时可能会损坏卡片。所以我为武器和盾牌准备了专用的拆卡技能...

scripts.text: Generally the fee is 1,000,000 Zeny. During the card separation, you can use ^990000special items that reduce the rate of destroying equipment or cards^000000. We don't charge additional zeny for this.
scripts.translation: 通常费用是1,000,000金币。拆卡时可以使用^990000降低装备或卡片损坏概率的特殊道具^000000。使用它们不额外收取金币。

scripts.text: There is a possibility of destroying them even using a special item. Also, ^ff0000the refine level might be lost^000000. Do you have any equipment to separate?
scripts.translation: 即使用了特殊道具，装备或卡片仍有可能损坏。而且^ff0000精炼等级也可能会消失^000000。你有要拆卡的装备吗？

scripts.text: Stop the work
scripts.translation: 停止作业

scripts.text: Whenever you need the work, visit me here.
scripts.translation: 需要时随时来这里找我。

scripts.text: You wonder what is so special. Well, I hate to give only a guide, so let me tell you the story...
scripts.translation: 你想知道特别之处是什么？我不喜欢只做说明，还是给你讲讲背后的故事吧...

scripts.text: ^000099Jeremy is stretching his shoulders and hands. He might be waiting for someone to talk with him.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099杰里米正在伸展肩膀和双手。他似乎在等人和他搭话。^000000

scripts.text: Do you know that Malangdo's specialty is canned food?
scripts.translation: 你知道马兰岛的特产是罐头吗？

scripts.text: I knew that well. Is it that limited?
scripts.translation: 我早就知道了。种类很少吗？

scripts.text: Hehe... Everyone loves it. But there were some problems before.
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿...大家都喜欢。不过以前有些问题。

scripts.text: Problems? Is there any faulty fish?
scripts.translation: 问题？鱼有瑕疵吗？

scripts.text: No, the fish does not have any problem. The problem is lots of fish oil produced after processing. That is such an industrial waste.
scripts.translation: 不，鱼没问题。问题是加工后会产生大量鱼油，那可是工业废弃物。

scripts.text: However, after a revitalizing refining process, this fish oil became valuable to use for old equipment care and industrial lubricant.
scripts.translation: 不过，经过重新提炼处理后，鱼油就能用于保养旧装备和工业润滑，变得很有价值。

scripts.text: In addition, this oil is so useful to separate relics from equipped weapons that we can't buy Premium Lubricant and Ordinary Lubricant with Zeny.
scripts.translation: 此外，这种油很适合从装备中的武器上拆下古物，所以我们不收金币卖高级润滑剂和普通润滑剂。

scripts.text: Well, don't worry about money. Surely the Premium Lubricant is expensive. If you pay some zeny, I can give you cheaper lubricant.
scripts.translation: 放心，费用不是问题。高级润滑剂确实很贵，不过你付些金币，我就能给你便宜点的润滑剂。

scripts.text: I'm not sure about the quality of success. Anyway, this is so cheap, right?
scripts.translation: 我不敢保证成功率。不过这个价格确实很便宜，对吧？

scripts.text: In this part, there is nothing?
scripts.translation: 那个部位没有东西吗？

scripts.text: There is nothing on that part?
scripts.translation: 那个部位什么也没有吗？

scripts.text: The card is not equipped. Do you want to check again?
scripts.translation: 卡片没有装备上。要再检查一次吗？

scripts.text: [Richard]
scripts.translation: [理查德]

scripts.text: Which number socket do you want to separate the card? From the left socket, they are sorted 1,2,3,4.
scripts.translation: 你想拆下第几个插槽里的卡片？从左边起依次是1、2、3、4号。

scripts.text: Stop the work
scripts.translation: 停止作业

scripts.text: Whenever you need to work, please come to me.
scripts.translation: 需要作业时，请随时来找我。

scripts.text: This socket is not equipped with any card. Why don't you check again?
scripts.translation: 这个插槽没有装备卡片。要不要再检查一下？

scripts.text: Except cards, ^ff0000all enchanted effects will disappear.^000000 If you agree to this, please choose the work type:
scripts.translation: 除了卡片以外，^ff0000所有附魔效果都会消失。^000000如果你同意，请选择作业类型：

scripts.text: Please choose the working fee.
scripts.translation: 请选择作业费用。

scripts.text: Whenever you need the work, visit me here.
scripts.translation: 需要时随时来这里找我。

scripts.text: You don't have enough zeny. Please come back with enough fees.
scripts.translation: 你的金币不够。准备好足够的费用后再来。

scripts.text: This is pretty old equipment. There is a high rate of destroying the cards or equipment during the work. Are you sure you want to continue?
scripts.translation: 这件装备相当老旧，作业时卡片或装备损坏的概率很高。确定要继续吗？

scripts.text: Next time...
scripts.translation: 下次再说...

scripts.text: Continue
scripts.translation: 继续

scripts.text: Whenever you need the work, visit me here.
scripts.translation: 需要时随时来这里找我。

scripts.text: You don't have Premium Lubricant.
scripts.translation: 你没有高级润滑剂。

scripts.text: If you use the Premium Lubricant, the rate of destruction will be decreased highly, but I can't give you a 100% guarantee. Are you sure you want to continue?
scripts.translation: 使用高级润滑剂可以大幅降低损坏概率，但我无法保证百分之百安全。确定要继续吗？

scripts.text: Next time...
scripts.translation: 下次再说...

scripts.text: Continue
scripts.translation: 继续

scripts.text: Whenever you need the work, visit me here.
scripts.translation: 需要时随时来这里找我。

scripts.text: You don't have Ordinary Lubricant.
scripts.translation: 你没有普通润滑剂。

scripts.text: If you use the Ordinary Lubricant, the rate of destruction will be decreased highly, but I can't give you a 100% guarantee. Are you sure you want to continue?
scripts.translation: 使用普通润滑剂可以大幅降低损坏概率，但我无法保证百分之百安全。确定要继续吗？

scripts.text: Next time...
scripts.translation: 下次再说...

scripts.text: Continue
scripts.translation: 继续

scripts.text: Whenever you need the work, visit me here.
scripts.translation: 需要时随时来这里找我。

scripts.text: This equipment contains a precious MVP card. This card can't be separated with lubricant. If you bring the super surfactant ^0000ffSillit Pong^000000, I will be able to work.
scripts.translation: 这件装备上有珍贵的MVP卡片。润滑剂无法拆下这张卡片。如果你带来超级表面活性剂^0000ff希利特庞^000000， 我就能帮你处理。

scripts.text: Next time...
scripts.translation: 下次再说...

scripts.text: I have a Sillit Pong.
scripts.translation: 我有希利特庞。

scripts.text: Whenever you need the work, visit me here.
scripts.translation: 需要时随时来这里找我。

scripts.text: You don't have Sillit Pong.
scripts.translation: 你没有希利特庞。

scripts.translation: 除了卡片以外，^ff0000所有附魔效果都会消失。^000000如果你同意，请选择作业类型：

scripts.text: May I continue?
scripts.translation: 可以继续吗？
